result:
All tests pass, and only intended files changed. Summary of changes:

- **`crates/smysl-provider/src/usage.rs`**: added `Ledger::default_path()`, which resolves `.smysl/usage.log` under the user's home directory (`HOME`/`USERPROFILE`), falling back to the old relative path if no home directory can be found. Added a `home_dir()` helper and unit tests covering both branches and an empty-var edge case.
- **`src/main.rs`**: `ingest` and `usage` now open the ledger via `Ledger::default_path()` instead of resolving it against the project/store directory.
- **`tests/dispatch.rs`**: isolates `HOME`/`USERPROFILE` to each command's scratch directory so the dispatch test can't write into the real developer home directory, and updated the stale comment.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`**: documented the behavior change under `Unreleased — 1.4.0`.

Both `cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast` pass, as do `--all-features` and `--no-default-features` builds. No commit was made, per your instructions.
